reviews.name: Contender

reviews.name: AP Heavy Machine Gun

reviews.name: Akrylat-Kanone

reviews.name: Spitfire

reviews.name: AP Spitfire

reviews.name: Smoke Grenades
reviews.reason: N5.3 p. 178: Smoke Ammunition, no PS or Saving Roll, B1, short range MOD 0 and -3 at medium range; Speculative Attack, BS Weapon (PH), circular Impact Template, Non-lethal, Targetless, and [**] Ammunition footnote. The canonical Smoke visibility-zone rule, not an ARM/BTS attack, owns the zero-visibility placement and opposed-roll conditions. The Trait links own PH-based attacks, Speculative Attack, Targetless and Template placement.

reviews.name: Grenades
reviews.reason: N5.3 p. 178: Normal Ammunition, PS 7/B1, one ARM Saving Roll, +3 short-range MOD; Speculative Attack, BS Weapon (PH), circular Impact Template, without Non-lethal or Targetless. The canonical Normal Ammunition and individually linked Traits supply all published mechanics.

reviews.name: E/M Grenades
reviews.reason: N5.3 p. 178: E/M Ammunition, PS 7/B1, two BTS/2 Saving Rolls, +3 short-range MOD; Speculative Attack, BS Weapon (PH), circular Impact Template, Non-lethal and [**] Ammunition footnote. E/M target effects and non-Wound State outcomes are covered by canonical E/M and Non-lethal references; [**] does not create an extra attack effect.

reviews.name: Eclipse Grenades

Canonical Eclipse visibility-zone rules explicitly handle Reflective blocking of MSV, separate from Smoke; the source Traits and ranges are preserved without a new grenade-specific rule.

reviews.name: AP Sniper Rifle

reviews.name: Breaker Rifle

reviews.name: AP Red Fury

reviews.reason: N5.3 Weapon Chart p. 179, Army and captured English/Spanish Wiki agree: PS --, B1, Eclipse Ammunition, no Saving Roll, Reflective, Non-Lethal, Speculative Attack, Targetless and Circular Impact Template. reviews.name: Jammer
reviews.reason: N5.3 Weapon Chart p. 187, imported Army, and captured English and Spanish Wiki chart rows agree on WIP-based PS 7/B1, Normal Ammunition, one BTS Saving Roll, BS Weapon (WIP), Comms Attack, Intuitive Attack, Disposable (2), Isolated, Non-Lethal, No LoF and Zone of Control. The canonical BS Weapon (WIP), Intuitive Attack, Disposable and Non-Lethal Traits, Comms Attack and No LoF Labels, and Isolated State are public linked references. Comms Attack is countered with Reset rather than Dodge; no Jammer-only effect or targeting mode is printed. Null Trait slugs on Labels and State are intentional; public_reference resolves them.

reviews.name: Katyusha MRL

Army and captured English/Spanish Wiki charts agree on range modifiers -3/+3/+3/0/0/-6. The PDF's unsigned 3 is a confirmed missing plus sign per pinned RR-SRC-N53-003 and config/validation/weapon-range-source-review.json; preserve the raw printed source anomaly. Canonical DA and linked Traits cover all effects; no unique Katyusha-only mechanic.

reviews.name: Light Rocket Launcher

reviews.name: Plasma Rifle
reviews.reason: Official N5.3 pp. 67/183, imported Army and archived English/Spanish Wiki agree: Blast PS 7 and Hit PS 6, both B3 with Normal Ammunition, one ARM plus one BTS Saving Roll, and Suppressive Fire; only Blast has a Circular Impact Template. A Critical adds one ARM roll, not BTS. Both modes already resolve the shared Plasma Weapon Property and typed Combined Saving Roll; no duplicated Plasma Rifle-specific mechanics are needed.

reviews.name: Plasma Carbine
reviews.reason: Official N5.3 pp. 67/176, imported Army and archived English/Spanish Wiki agree: Blast PS 7 and Hit PS 6, both B2 with Normal Ammunition and one ARM plus one BTS Saving Roll; only Blast has a Circular Impact Template. Neither mode has Suppressive Fire. A Critical adds one ARM roll only. Existing Plasma Weapon Property, Combined Saving Roll and Impact Template references suffice; do not inherit Plasma Rifle's Suppressive Fire.

reviews.name: Trench-Hammer
reviews.reason: Official N5.3 pp. 68 and 177, Army and the current EN/ES Wiki Weapon Charts agree: the BS mode uses the BS Weapon (PH) Trait and a zero short-range MOD, while the CC mode uses CC; both have PS 6, B1, DA Ammunition, two ARM Saving Rolls, Anti-materiel, and source [*] notation. The official N5.3 update expressly removed Disposable (3) from both uses; older Wiki alternative entries retain that historical trait and must not be applied as current. The existing DA, Anti-materiel, BS Weapon (PH), CC and Mixed Weapons rules cover the mechanics.

reviews.name: Vorpal CC Weapon
reviews.reason: Official N5.3 p. 177, Army and EN/ES Wiki Weapon Charts agree: BS and CC modes both have PS 8, B1, Normal Ammunition, ARM=0 and one Saving Roll, with State: Dead and [*] source notation. BS mode uses BS Weapon (PH) and +3 at 8 inches; CC mode uses CC without a ranged profile. Canonical Normal Ammunition, Dead State, BS Weapon (PH), CC and Mixed Weapons describe the mechanics. Do not rename the printed N Ammunition as a newly invented Vorpal or Monofilament ammunition.

reviews.name: MULTI Red Fury
reviews.reason: Official N5.3 p. 183, Army and EN/ES Wiki Weapon Charts agree: Anti-materiel mode PS 7, B1, DA, two ARM Saving Rolls and Anti-materiel; AP mode PS 7, B4, AP/ARM/2 with one roll; Shock mode PS 7, B4, Shock/ARM with one roll. Suppressive Fire appears only in AP and Shock modes. All three share 0/+3/-3/-6 range bands. The existing MULTI Weapon Property and linked DA/AP/Shock Ammunition and Traits describe each alternative firing mode; do not transfer Suppressive Fire to the DA mode.

reviews.name: Uragan MRL
reviews.reason: Official N5.3 p. 188, Army and EN/ES Wiki Weapon Charts agree on Blast PS 6 and Hit PS 5, both B3 with combined AP+Shock Ammunition, one ARM/2 Saving Roll, and Burst: Single Target. Blast adds Speculative Attack and Circular Impact Template; Hit does not. Canonical AP+Shock Weapon Property and linked Traits cover the separate modes. The Spanish Wiki names Hit Mode 'Uragan MTL' instead of MRL; preserve this as a source text-name discrepancy, not evidence of a new weapon identity. Burst: Single Target restricts all B3 shots to one target, not B1.
